question: Is establishment of the pot permitted at the tip of the liṅga?
premises: An altar ground may be at the tip of the liṅga
Establishment of the pot is considered there
inference: One should not establish the pot at the tip of the liṅga.
uncertainties: The exact force of nuhi is slightly unclear but read as emphatic negation
plain_english: At the tip of the liṅga there may be an altar ground, but the pot should not be established there.
